LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_EponaBloodline.label: (Raven) Epona Bloodline (Minor)
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_EponaBloodline.description:
A sturdy bloodline branch from the Epona race. It grants greater carrying capacity and base move speed, and lets the bearer gradually accelerate while moving outdoors.

Effects:
- Base move speed +0.2
- Carrying capacity +15
